roadmap: Stage 1 — Play the story: finish the Prologue and Chapters 1-5, doing Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before it ends, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter plus one before the final mission. There is no mission replay.
Stage 2 — Side stories: finish the final missions for Kenton, Billy, Andy, Randy and Tyrone, Bret's hunting questline, and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands.
Stage 3 — Open-world cleanup: stunts, races, shooting ranges, drone races, collectibles, robberies and exploration, tracking progress under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Stage 4 — 100% completion: attain 100% Completion for A Long Road, then the Platinum pops.
Safety rules: never use cheats on the trophy save (cheats disable trophies and saving), and keep manual saves because there is no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Expect a long haul: the story alone runs around 60 hours and full completion is commonly estimated near 200 hours, with no online trophies and no difficulty trophies in the way. Follow the roadmap in order — story, side stories, open-world cleanup, then 100% completion — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, since the game has no mission replay. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag, Push Square.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist, which only appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but work done earlier still counts toward it. The checklist is a 35-task list covering the story, stunts (300 of them for 100%, versus 250 for the Cunning Stunts trophy), vehicles (200 of 277 discovered), challenges (70 of 80) and the rest of the open-world tasks. Do the bulk of it after the credits, when every region and activity is open. Sources: OutputLag, GTAViceCityHub, Push Square.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total, and there are 397 stunts in the game, so you only need a little over half of them. Keep going past 250, because 100% completion wants 300. Sources: OutputLag, Push Square.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 gold medals across the game's two shooting ranges. Treat each range as its own checklist and work through its challenges one at a time; gold is a score bar to clear, not a race against other players, so repeat a challenge until the medal lands. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone. A vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist wants all eight vaults. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not, because they have their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see whether it moved. Strands stay available after the story, so this is cleanup work rather than a race. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so treat this as a collecting run: sweep one region at a time and use the WAiNK app to log spots as you go. You only need three finished sets, not every card in the game. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game app for scanning and logging places, and the same scanning also counts vehicles toward Whip It Good, so make a habit of scanning traffic and landmarks as you drive instead of treating this as a separate grind. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — there are nine activity types in the game. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample one of each: a race, a shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, a drone race, a stunt, a gym session and the rest of the list. This pops early if you poke at everything as it unlocks. Sources: PlanetGTA6, GGRecon.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replaying the same race does not count twice — the 20 must be distinct events, so work through the race list across Leonida instead of farming one favourite. Races stay open after the story. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely — the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The easiest route is a bank vault job, which hands you 4 stars straight away; escape with your partner and it pops. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, and you can then call the other one in as your partner. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain breaks if the Wanted Level fades and you are only in the red heat zone, so pick three shops close together and move fast between them. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and this fills up on its own. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map. Drive the highways, visit the towns and the coast, and the trophy pops once the map is fully revealed. It pairs naturally with the collecting trophies, so sweep regions for cards, meditation spots and WAiNK locations as you explore. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal Operations are marked gang turf you can hit; the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way to that bigger goal. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you sell them on to your contacts to clean them; the $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole playthrough. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — there are 14 drone race locations. You need at least one win at each, not a win at every race each location offers, so work through the location list one by one. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food and the rest — so it climbs as you play normally, and any big post-story shopping spree for garages and gear closes the gap. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count — only the ones you buy. Buy garages early too, because each registered car needs a free garage space. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens as an activity in the open world; find Cal's challenge, land the better catch and the trophy pops. It is a single head-to-head challenge, not a grind. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any of the four in-game arcade games counts. Walk up to a cabinet, play it through to the end, and the trophy pops on completion. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 required spots. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter ends. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time): she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate, and you follow her and accept the optional task. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. There is no mission replay, so a missed spot means a second playthrough. Sources: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GGRecon.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an Illegal Operation, and use an assault rifle so the kills come fast; Adrenaline extends Focus if the window runs short. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run their routes around Leonida; hit one, grab the cash and break away from the police. Like Hot Together, this trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep working the list past 50. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission and it is unmissable — play through the opening and the trophy pops at the end of it. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it does not fire the instant the final mission ends. Before Chapter 1 closes, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the list's only missable trophy. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, which opens up most of the open-world list, so use this chapter to start the partner trophies and the collecting. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. This chapter opens the jewelry store robberies through Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, and the Race Against Yago street race in this chapter is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and counts toward Strangers & Freaks — save first, then race the moment it appears. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Bank vault jobs unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of this chapter, so do that mission before the chapter closes and start the vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission — the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your safety net for anything you still need to do in the story. After the credits, the 100% checklist appears and everything outside the story stays available. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. This one matters beyond its own trophy: finishing it opens switching between Jason and Lucia, which is what makes the partner trophies and most of the open-world list possible. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is an unmissable story trophy — play the mission through and it pops at the end. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable: finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable: finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable: finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable: finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a side-story finale that stays open after the main story, so you can finish it during post-game cleanup if you have not done it yet. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a side-story finale that stays open after the main story. Note that Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a side-story finale that stays open after the main story, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a side-story finale that stays open after the main story, so it can be finished during post-game cleanup. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a side-story finale that stays open after the main story, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. Take a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks are reported parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The official description is the method: find a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view over the water, order a cocktail and drink it there. Sources: PlanetGTA6, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The official description is all the game gives: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. One guide suggests crashing a car out through a showroom window, but EGamers marks the steps unconfirmed and PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so treat the showroom drive-through as a guess to try, not a verified step. Check back for a confirmed method before grinding it. Sources: EGamers, U7Buy, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an Illegal Operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. Sources: OutputLag, PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The official description is a riddle — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — and no source has confirmed the trigger. The leading suggestion is that it pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength, which would mean buying a gym membership and training with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. OutputLag hedges this as 'should pop', GTAViceCityHub lists it as not known yet, and EGamers cites GTABase for the Strength theory, so train with your partner and treat the pop as unconfirmed until a second source verifies it. Sources: OutputLag, EGamers, GTAViceCityHub.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the count, so it fills up without a separate grind if you play the open world actively — robberies, fights and other profile-changing acts all count. One source only (GTABase via EGamers) gives the 500 figure, so treat the number as reported, not official. Sources: EGamers, OutputLag.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The official description — 'Second time's the charm' — is the only hint the game gives, and no guide has confirmed what triggers it. It is listed as a story-adjacent trophy you pick up by playing rather than hunting, so keep playing and check the trophy list after story moments; do not chase a specific method until one is verified. Sources: U7Buy, EGamers, GTAViceCityHub.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. KeenGamer lists this outright as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, and U7Buy says the exact trigger remains unverified. One guide suggests a UFO random encounter in Kelly County, but that is itself unconfirmed. Do not grind a specific spot for it; play on, and check back once a second source verifies the trigger. Sources: KeenGamer, U7Buy, EGamers.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The official description points at a melee drive-by at the bowling alley, but no source has confirmed the exact conditions — U7Buy says the precise conditions remain under investigation and EGamers marks the steps unconfirmed. The plain reading is to knock bowling pins over with a melee drive-by, so try it at Kingpin Bowling, but treat that as a guess until a guide verifies it. Sources: U7Buy, EGamers, GTAViceCityHub.
